data.body: AC amendment (gap analysis 5/6): Specify subprocess.Popen fire-and-forget hardening. Without stdio+session detach: child can block parent on PIPE fill, be reaped on parent exit, or become zombie. AC must require: stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL, close_fds=True, start_new_session=True. Also: wrapper registers atexit handler calling Popen.poll() on each emitted child to reap finished ones. RED test: spawn 10 events, kill parent, assert no zombies + no FileDescriptorWarning.
